Preserve his exact identity and proportions, do not redesign him. Create a new landscape sprite sheet EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 32 uniformly spaced cells. Every cell contains the same hero seated safely INSIDE a tiny improvised boat made from HALF OF A CLEAR PALE AQUA PLASTIC WATER BOTTLE CUT LENGTHWISE, bottle cap still on its narrow bow, moulded ribs and rounded scalloped plastic stern recognizable, a small twig seat inside. TWO SMALL TWIG OARS with broad green LEAF BLADES, one on each side; his hands grip the sticks. NO second passenger. Whole craft and all leaf oars completely within every cell, lots of empty padding, stable actor-to-hull proportions and hull registration between rows. EIGHT camera-relative directions column order LEFT TO RIGHT: bow toward bottom, bottom-right, right, top-right, top, top-left, left, bottom-left. Do NOT rotate the whole flat picture: draw the corresponding top-down three-quarter view as the boat turns. Camera remains the reference camera. Each column is one direction throughout the four rows. ROW 4: both elbows back, oars finish aft. Only his arms, torso and oars move across rows, not the hull position or design. Entire objects centered and separated on a clean regular grid. High detail source master intended for offline reduction to 2x game texture density.
